title: This Canyon Echoes Whoever MISSES You 🏜️
description:
Out here, if you shout your name at the canyon, it answers in the voice of whoever misses you most. People hear their moms. One woman heard her old dog.

I moved out west in May, and my dad hasn't called once. So I shouted mine.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment ECHO if you'd shout yours.
